description: Build an UNSIGNED tx that collects all uncollected fees from a Uniswap v3 position to `recipient`. Returns tx={to,data,value,chainId} plus rlp (the unsigned EIP-1559 serialization for signing services). When simulated, simulationResult={amount0,amount1} — the actual amounts eth_call reports would be collected. Set simulate=false to skip the eth_call dry-run (on by default).
name: build_collect
title: Build a collect-fees transaction
